about: Steel Authority of India Limited, a steel-making company, manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India and internationally. The company offers a range of railway products, which include rail, high YS/UTS rail, corrosion-resistant micro-alloyed rail, vanadium alloyed rail, end forged thick web asymmetric rail, conductivity rail, crane rails, and crossing sleeper bars. It also provides pig iron, cold rolled products, pipes, semis, structurals, sail tmt bars, galvanized products, wirerod
